title: Sort it out
story: We have a list of all employees who accessed the server today.
But the logs are out of order and there are duplicates.
Find the one employee who accessed it exactly ONE time.
objective: Submit the name of the user who appears exactly once in access.log.
hints: 'uniq' only detects adjacent duplicates. Try sorting the file first with 'sort' and piping it to 'uniq'.
